text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the day of the Sprinters Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't be readier. If I can't manage a
victory
here, surpassing the Mile
Emperor will become
but a dream
beyond a dream.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I'll blow the competition away with
hurricane
winds and seize the win for
certain.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
BAKUSHIN! BAKUSHIIIN!
Hey, it's
Zephyr!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Bakushin O. Thank you for all your help
at
summer camp.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Don't mention it! In fact, thanks to that time we spent training together, I ended up acquiring an even more explosive Bakushin!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
On a scale of one to SHIN, my
Bakushin's at
about a SHIN-SHIN-SHIN!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
In short, I won't be losing to any raging
winds!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... How very like you. You're such a
gust of
energy.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Right, let's settle it today. Let's find out
which of
us is the fiercest wind.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Zephyr! Um...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I'm not going to lose today!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Flower... You're more than a floral wind

today—you stand as if wrapped in a
typhoon.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
We ran together a whole lot at summer
camp, and
I kept catching myself being
in total awe of you.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
But that's why I want to face you
head-on and
win!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Because then I'll have shown everyone I
can be
brave!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...A propitious flurry has blown in. I'm so
very
blessed.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Both Bakushin O and Flower have
brought the
dauntless energy of a
derecho to this race.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
So I shall breathe in every ounce of that
energy...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: And become a breakneck tempest!
